title: text_import: just suppress the two-initializers warning.
description:
Stick with the simpler "init everything to invalid, and then override
that" mechanism, and just turn off the warning for thse structures.

commits_data.message:
text_import: just suppress the two-initializers warning.

Stick with the simpler "init everything to invalid, and then override
that" mechanism, and just turn off the warning for thse structures.
